  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Removes process-global index instances across src/index/ and transfers ownership to NodeContext.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Transfers ownership of secondary indexes from global singletons into NodeContext, improving encapsulation and test isolation. As noted in the description, removing global singletons like '`g_txindex`' and '`g_coin_stats_index`' decouples index lifecycle from process-wide state, but does not alter index data integrity, sync performance, or correctness."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/net_processing only to update index retrieval via callback rather than global state.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The edits in net_processing are mechanical call-site updates following the relocation of index ownership."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches RPC files only to fetch index instances from NodeContext.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The RPC and REST changes are mechanical follow-ups passing NodeContext index references, without modifying interface semantics or adding features."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to fuzz harnesses and test utilities simply adapt to NodeContext index ownership.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Test changes follow mechanically from the index ownership refactor rather than changing testing harness infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches init.cpp only for secondary index initialization and shutdown within NodeContext.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Adjustments in init.cpp merely rewire secondary index construction into NodeContext and do not alter shared utility primitives."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Carries the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label, but deals entirely with optional secondary indexes under src/index/.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Validation specifically excludes changes whose primary subject is optional secondary indexes in src/index/."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches only src/wallet/test/rescan_tests.cpp to adapt to the new index setup API.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change in wallet rescan tests is purely mechanical follow-up code."
    }
